title: Market readiness checklist for pricing structure refresh
creator: Anika Shah
description: Goal: Coordinate a cross-functional market readiness plan for the pricing and packaging refresh so customers experience a clear, low-friction migration. Scope includes SKU consolidation mapping, tiered limits and quotas, billing pipeline changes, console UI copy and entitlements, release notes cadence, sales + support enablement, customer comms timeline, and rollback criteria. Excludes contract renegotiation for enterprise customers (handled separately).
tasks: Finalize SKU mapping spreadsheet and migration mapping (owner: PM) — include legacy SKU -> new SKU, token equivalence, and limit translation rules
Confirm billing pipeline changes with Finance/Payments (owner: ENG) — PR checklist, invoice delta test cases, and dry-run environment
Draft customer-facing release notes and migration FAQs (owner: Docs) — plain-language impacts, timeline, and examples for token usage
Prepare in-console banner and modal content (owner: Design + Console Eng) — A/B messaging for free tier vs paid customers
Create sales enablement pack (owner: Growth) — one-pager, migration cheat sheet, objection handling, pricing calculator spreadsheet
Set up feature flags and gradual rollout plan (owner: ENG) — canary cohorts, 0%->100% schedule, and automatic rollback triggers
Run billing dry-run on staging with subset of real customer invoices (owner: Finance + ENG) — compare billing outputs to current system
Create monitoring and alerts (owner: Observability) — revenue deltas, spike in errors, failed migrations, support volume thresholds
Legal & compliance check for messaging and entitlements (owner: Legal) — ensure no unexpected contractual breach language
Train Support and Sales SMEs (owner: CS + Sales Ops) — two live sessions + recorded FAQ walkthrough
Prepare partner and reseller comms (owner: Partnerships) — reseller migration timeline and required contract amendments
Coordinate cutover window and blackout times with ops (owner: PM + Infra) — date, rollback windows, on-call roster
Publish final release notes and distribution plan (owner: PM) — blog, email templates, in-console, changelog entry
acceptance_criteria: SKU mapping validated and signed off by Finance/Revenue ops
Billing dry-run shows no material invoice delta outside expected tolerances
Release notes and FAQs published to staging and approved by Legal
Sales and Support training completed and recorded session available
Console copy and modals are implemented behind feature flag and QA passed
Monitoring dashboards in place with alert thresholds and runbooks
Cutover date scheduled with rollback plan and on-call assignments
Customer comms templates (email + in-console) approved and ready for send
